reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was "Every batch lab-tested" with a QR code, which is nice, but it's a brand with zero reviews and I don't buy supplements without hundreds of reviews I can read the 1-star ones in. The box says nothing about capsule size, and two capsules at a time is a swallowing risk for me.
objection: No reviews, so I can't check the complaints about capsule size, stomach upset or whether the dose is real. A QR code is the brand's own claim until other buyers back it up. $1 a day is also more than the bottles I already use.
would_change_my_mind: Several hundred reviews with a decent rating and few complaints about pill size or stomach, plus the capsule size stated on the listing.
